definitions.explanation: Severely negative criticism or evaluation. Used when something is reviewed or judged very harshly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批評家|ひひょうか}→批評家：19430_hihyouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{酷評|こくひょう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was harshly criticized by reviewers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酷評|こくひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧だった。
examples.english: The new work faced a storm of harsh criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦{当初|とうしょ}→当初：12503_tousho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酷評|こくひょう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was harshly criticized at release but was later recognized as a masterpiece.

notes:
{酷評|こくひょう} combines {酷|こく} (harsh, cruel) and {評|ひょう} (critique, evaluation). It describes criticism that is not merely negative but notably severe or scathing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {酷評|こくひょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harshly criticize
- {酷評|こくひょう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be harshly criticized (passive, more common)
- {酷評|こくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive harsh criticism
- {酷評|こくひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧: a storm of harsh criticism
- {酷評|こくひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧: to be showered with harsh criticism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧: favorable reception
- ⟦{絶賛|ぜっさん}→絶賛：13840_zessan⟧: high praise, rave reviews
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: criticism (more neutral, less extreme)

USAGE:
Commonly used about creative works (films, books, performances), products, or public figures. Often appears in media and reviews.
